ns2:section.sectionText: "Latina/os on the Bronze Screen" Critical, historical and theoretical exploration of Latino representations in U.S. film from the 1900s to the present. Examination of cinematic representations as well as the social, political, and cultural context in which those representations are produced. The focus is on Mexican American and Puerto Rican images, but Hollywood?s treatment of other Latino communities and ethnic groups will be discussed. Students will be required to attend weekly movie screenings.
